summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.

verdict.line: Picture a busy homeowner who wants a gym in a small space. Mirror’s slim design, live and on‑demand classes, and easy app make it the best all‑in‑one solution, though it costs $1,495 upfront and $39/month. The catch: it doesn’t support third‑party apps or smart‑home platforms.
